SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS QUOTATION_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS QUOTATION_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'REDOWN' AND IF_FLAG IN ('N','T') GROUP BY KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'MOTR' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(PLANT,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(KEY_1,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, NVL(KEY_2,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, NVL(REVISION_NO,'01') AS REVISION, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(SPECIFICATION,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, NVL(UNIT_PRICE, 0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, NVL(REQ_USER_ID,' ') AS ADD_USER_ID, NVL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, NVL(REQ_USER_TELNO,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, NVL(REQ_USER_MAIL,' ') AS REQ_USER_MAIL, NVL(CLOSE_DATE,' ') AS CLOSE_DATE, NVL(CLOSE_TIME,' ') AS CLOSE_TIME, NVL(ITEM_QTY, 0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM V_KEP_RE, KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'REDOWN' AND KEY_1 = QUOTATION_NO(+) AND KEY_2 = QUOTATION_SEQ(+) AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG IN ('N','T') ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), KEY_5 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'REDOWN' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG IN ('N','T')
